label: late original / <DEL> steps in sequences opening with z/g/h/m/3 (weak)
explanation: Sparse feature (0.04% of steps). Never fires at t<3; mass is about 38% on the <DEL> step, 46% on late original steps (orig_idx 5-8), and 16% in the copy phase (often on input z). Activity is enriched when the sequence opens with tokens from {z,g,h,m,3} (first_tok z 6.6x, out_tok/next_out z,m,h,3,g strongly enriched) and on input z/w/n. But no predicate gets precision above about 10%: most sequences that open with these tokens never activate, so it looks like a specific distributed hidden-state configuration. Best dev predicate (first three tokens all in {z,g,h,m,3}, t>=5, original or <DEL> phase) reached F1 0.10 and mass recall 0.17. Broader versions reach mass recall 0.5-0.65 at precision under 2.5%. Magnitude rises a little when the first two tokens are in the set (top-quartile coverage 0.54 vs 0.34 bottom). Does not fire on early original steps, and rarely fires late in the copy phase.
